name: Tiny McDaniel
original_name: タイ二ー・マクダニエル
source: Tiny McDaniel is a new officer in the elite police force protecting New York City, Captain Vaneast.  Although she dreams of having a brilliant career like her brother and grandfather, so far she's stuck doing small jobs like fixing the coffee maker.  One night as she sneaks off to try and handle a high-profile case on her own, a horrific crime occurs, plunging the once-peaceful city into the depths of a nightmare...
